title: Critical Vulnerability Detected
description: Fires when the vulnerability correlation finds critical-severity CVEs in installed software that has to be updated by hand. Software that updates itself, such as browsers, is listed in the vulnerability report but does not trigger this rule.
author: Autopilot Monitor
explanation: The device has installed software with critical vulnerabilities that an update of the software has to close. CVEs rated CRITICAL (CVSS >= 9.0) were found in software that is updated through your deployment. Findings listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog are known to be used in attacks and should be remediated first. Software that updates itself, such as browsers, is not counted here, because it is expected to bring itself up to date after enrollment. Its findings are still listed in the vulnerability report.

remediation.title: Review vulnerability findings
steps: Open the Vulnerability Report section in the session detail
Identify all software with critical or KEV-flagged vulnerabilities
Check if newer versions are available that address these CVEs
Update the affected software in your Intune app deployment

remediation.title: Update deployment packages
steps: Check Intune for outdated app package versions
Update the deployment package to the latest patched version

presentation.summary: Critical CVEs in software that needs a manual update: {{critical_vulnerabilities.value}}
